title: The piste map
notes: Normal game camera over the whole resort with the hub's piste map on (the check box at the top of the hub's Runs view, opened with the Runs open tile at 3125, 300; it draws while the hub is open). photoMode.setOverlayHidden must be false (it hides the piste map). The eight 'Powerline Not Connected - Low' icons (all on lift stations, all in frame) were deleted with the sim paused, in one batch, then 60 frames and a status check; no other icon was touched. The UI view is hidden with the ui step. A crane from zoom 1700 to 1450 (tilt 55 to 50) with a 10 degree orbit (yaw 17 to 27) around (3519, 1160, -2322): the storyboard's pivot (3300, 1129, -2420) at zoom 700 to 550 showed only the base and the lower runs, so the pivot moved up the resort and the zoom out until every run, the bases and the town fit. Take 2 at sim 15:00 (a time jump to the next day), take 1 at about 16:50. Capture mode (fps 30, capture 60). The camera moves little per frame at this distance, so rec.mjs dedupe (mpdecimate) drops real frames; these takes were deduplicated with a luma-difference threshold instead (keep a frame when its mean luma difference to the previous recorded frame, at 960 px, is over 0.15).
